The deﬁnition of dedicated hardware types allows a ﬂexible usage of the ECU Re-
source Template. Since the deﬁnition of hardware types and the applicable attributes
is speciﬁed as an AUTOSAR XML ﬁle itself it can be updated and extended without the
needs to update the AUTOSAR XML-Schema.
